answer: Place each newcomer in one island cohort of twenty, with voting weight starting at its nadir and rising only after six consecutive epochs of honest, non-transferable participation. If a member is proven fake, the whole island's weight freezes until an audit clears it, so an operator cannot wander in, vote, and vanish. An honest agent waits once. An attacker must sustain a separate honest-looking history for every fake, across many cohorts, for months, and each caught fake poisons its cohort, so flooding multiplies delay and exposure instead of votes, making a fake army slow and unprofitable.
